title: Lightly Smoky Egyptian Fish Kebabs
description: A smoky and flaky Egyptian dish featuring fish sauce and nuka-pickle, perfect for a post-workout meal, served on a hot stone plate.
instructions: Preheat the hot stone plate to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the tilapia pieces to the bowl and marinate for 15 minutes.
Thread the marinated tilapia pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the preheated hot stone plate and cook for 8 minutes, flipping halfway through.
While the fish is cooking, mix the chopped nuka-pickle with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Once the fish is cooked, serve immediately on the hot stone plate with the nuka-pickle mixture spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional smoked paprika and lemon wedges, if desired.
